graderOnly: The scope and the technical design are complete and consistent; DEV-001 needs no upstream change.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Pre-install layers 00-02 commit a small NestJS 11 TypeScript API (members-api) in three commits: skeleton with a health check, an in-memory members store, and the login endpoint (AuthController POST /auth/login calling AuthService.login) with a Jest unit test of AuthService. package.json lists @nestjs/throttler and the other stated dependencies; nothing configures ThrottlerModule. node_modules is absent and gitignored. Layer 50 commits Auditor context (which records that build and tests cannot run in this checkout), the scope with AC-001 as worded in the case, and the technical design (ThrottlerModule.forRoot limit 10 per 60000 ms in AuthModule, ThrottlerGuard on the login handler only, default in-memory storage). Layer 51 commits the APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan (User Style NONE, locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, single step DEV-001 PENDING for AC-001) and STATE.md at DEVELOPING / STANDARD / FULL_DELIVERABLE, BlockedOn NONE, Handoff FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, recovery inactive. Registries are blocked at runtime; selfChecks prove build, tests, registry fetches, and an install attempt fail. Compromise: no pnpm-lock.yaml is committed, because a hand-written lockfile for a NestJS dependency tree would be incomplete or invalid.
